name: replace_white_with_pink_noise
mechanism: Replaces white noise with pink noise to better model the natural 1/f energy roll-off characteristic of physiological fluid turbulence and sensor noise.

name: add_broadband_noise_to_heart_sounds
mechanism: Enhances heart sound realism by mixing low-pass filtered pink noise with the base frequency-modulated tonal component to create a broadband thud.

name: remove_high_frequency_click
mechanism: Removed the high-frequency click component from heart sound generation to produce a purely low-frequency broadband transient.

name: add_beat_to_beat_amplitude_variation
mechanism: Introduces stochastic beat-to-beat amplitude modulation for S1 and S2 heart sounds to better simulate natural physiological variability.

name: multi_tier_severity_parameterization
mechanism: Expands a binary severity model into a three-tier system with distinct amplitude and frequency band parameters to increase physiological diversity.

name: simulate_valve_closure_click
mechanism: Simulates the high-frequency click of valve closure by adding a high-pass filtered noise component with a rapid exponential decay to the heart sound.
